title: Strikethrough the original price of the experience ticket
goal: uses text-decoration to draw a strikethrough to clearly distinguish the original price and current price.
summary: text-decoration can add underline or strikethrough to text. line-through will cause a line to pass through the middle of the text.
tasks: Add line-through strikethrough to the original price with old-price category in the two experience tickets.
leaves the current price and other text on the same line as is.

example.note: exhibit introduction page can underline the "View details" link.

hint: line appears below the text, check whether it is written underline. When an entire line is crossed out, check to see if the style has been added to the outer paragraph.
